name: yilmaz-aygun-topological-defect-2005
description: I. Yilmaz, M. Aygun & S. Aygun's "Topological defect solutions in the spherically symmetric space-time admitting conformal motion" (arXiv gr-qc/0607104, published Gen. Rel. Grav. 37 (2005) 2093-2104) was withdrawn by arXiv administrators for excessive overlap with hep-th/0505013 -- a paper co-authored by the same Ihsan Yilmaz (with different coauthors Ilhami Yavuz and Husnu Baysal). Unlike the Aygun/Tarhan-vs-Xulu case in this directory's other example, this is same-author/collaborator reuse, not theft from an unrelated author -- arXiv's own note frames it that way ("papers also written by the authors or their collaborators"). Included as a genuine, arXiv-confirmed near-duplicate case, but labeled accurately as self/collaborator overlap rather than cross-author plagiarism -- useful for exercising dupefinder's same_author flag on a real case rather than only synthetic ones.
source_quote: This paper has excessive overlap with the following papers also written by the authors or their collaborators: hep-th/0505013 and 0705.2930. This submission has been withdrawn by arXiv administrators due to inappropriate text reuse from external sources.
found_by: arXiv administrators (automated/manual text-overlap review); publicized by Peter Woit, https://www.math.columbia.edu/~woit/wordpress/?p=638
